agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
June 3, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for May 6, 2026, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Eddy Delacruz,
  for Special Use Permit No. 26-00005(SUP26-00005) to allow a
  beauty salon within 300 feet of a similar use on a C-2 (General
  Commercial) zoned property at 650 West Arbor Vitae Street.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-053) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City Hall and via email request to
  bespinoza@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-053;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00005.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Inglewood
  Open Studios, to amend the installation of a mural on an existing
  one-story commercial building on an H-C (Historic Core) zoned
  property at 201 South Market Street.

  Notice of Exemptions (EA-CE-2026-063) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City Hall and via email request to smay@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-063;
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR26-00024.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
   C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents

8.  Planning Commission Report - Introduce for discussion and provide
  comments on the Proposed Comprehensive General Plan Draft Land Use
  Plan, Citywide.

  Planning Commission Action:
  A. Receive and File
  Item 8a Documents

9.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

10.  Commission Initiatives.

11.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of June 3, 2026, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 1, 2026, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
